text:
Predicates:
Pets(x) ::: x is a pet.
AllowedIn(x, y) ::: x is allowed in building y.
DepositRequired(y) ::: a deposit is required to rent in building y.
DepositAmount(y, z) ::: the deposit amount for building y is z.
Rent(y, z) ::: the monthly rent at building y is z.
Rents(x, y) ::: person x rents an apartment in building y.
MovesIn(x, y) ::: person x moves in with pet y.
Fluffy(x) ::: x is Fluffy.
Tom(x) ::: x is Tom.
OliveGarden(y) ::: y is the Olive Garden.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
Price(y) ::: y is a price value.
EqualOrMore(z, w) ::: z is equal to or more than w.
LessThan(z, w) ::: z is less than w.
AllowsPets(y) ::: building y allows pets.
SpecialDeposit(y, z) ::: the security deposit in building y can be z or more.
Premises:
Pets(Fluffy) ∧ AllowedIn(Fluffy, OliveGarden) ∧ AllowedIn(Tom, OliveGarden) ∧ Pets(Fluffy) ∧ AllowedIn(Fluffy, OliveGarden) ∧ DepositRequired(OliveGarden) ∧ DepositAmount(OliveGarden, 1500) ∧ Rent(OliveGarden, 2000) ∧ Year(1946) ∧ Book(methodOfStudyingGregorianChant) ∧ Author(miroslav, methodOfStudyingGregorianChant) ∧ Publish(methodOfStudyingGregorianChant, 1946) ∧ Specialize(miroslav, renaissance) ∧ Specialize(miroslav, baroque) ∧ Czech(miroslav) ∧ ChoralConductor(miroslav) ∧ Musician(miroslav) ∧ Love(miroslav, music) ∧ ∃x (Musician(x) ∧ Love(x, music)) ∧ ∃x (Czech(x) ∧ Author(x, y) ∧ Book(y) ∧ Publish(y, 1946))
Conclusion:
Rents(Tom, OliveGarden) ↔ (MovesIn(Tom, Fluffy) ∧ LessThan(DepositAmount(OliveGarden), 1500))
